title: v1.2 replacement for custody-10: Landed trees are right when the builder deletes, renames, sets chmod +x, adds a symlink, or commits by itself

reply.text:
Difficulty: easy

## Acceptance criteria
- A1: lib/greet.txt contains the line Hello, Almir!

## Technical approach
Replace the single line in lib/greet.txt.

## Implementation steps
1. Write Hello, Almir! to lib/greet.txt.

arguments.cmd: git rm -q lib/a.txt && git commit -q -m 'one' && git mv lib/b.txt lib/c.txt && git commit -q -m 'two' && chmod +x lib/run.sh && ln -s greet.txt lib/link.txt && printf 'Hello, Almir!\n' > lib/greet.txt

notes: Two builder commits plus uncommitted changes squash into one landing commit on the base tip. v1.2 replacement for custody-10. Text-only builder replies are progress; completion requires finish alone with {} (§3.6). Shell-recipe builders expose shell, finish, and tool_output (§4.7).

git.stdout_regex:

100644 blob [0-9a-f]+	lib/greet\.txt
120000 blob [0-9a-f]+	lib/link\.txt
100755 blob [0-9a-f]+	lib/run\.sh
\Z
